name: ValYou
description:
ValYou is a multi-currency net worth tracker. This connector gives Claude read-only access to your own ValYou data so you can ask questions about your finances in plain English and get answers grounded in your real numbers.

Claude can see your net worth and how it breaks down by category, your accounts and balances, your month-by-month history, and your wealth percentile ranking for your age and country. It can run retirement and what-if projections from your own figures, tell you who owes you and who you owe across shared expenses, and help you plan a monthly budget to find where you could save.

Example questions: "What's my net worth right now?" · "Where do I rank for my age?" · "Will I have enough to retire at 65?" · "How much does Alex owe me?" · "Help me build a budget so I can save more each month."

The connector is strictly read-only. It cannot move money, change settings, or modify anything in your account. It never exposes bank login credentials or account numbers, and every request is verified so you only ever see your own data. You can disconnect at any time from Claude's connector settings.

Budgets are a planning view of estimated costs, not a record of your actual spending. Split balances are shown per currency and are never converted between currencies. Projections are estimates based on your own trend and stated assumptions. They are not financial advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ValYou to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ValYou to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kojwpbbznaxyoxyqfacc.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ValYou MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ValYou provides these MCP tools: get_accounts, get_balance_history, get_net_worth, get_wealth_percentile, project_retirement, simulate_scenario, get_splits, and get_budget.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ValYou?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ValYou in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
ValYou requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ValYou is developed by ValYou LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
